13 Jun 2024
The claimant reported a rear-end collision at a stop and said they felt neck and shoulder pain shortly afterward. The
claimant is not represented by counsel, and the claim was opened with the policy details confirmed, including that the
driver is named on the policy.
6 Jul 2024
Police and two independent witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle at the time of the impact, and the other
driver's account matches the claimant's description of how the crash happened. Scene photos were also obtained
and are consistent with the reported sequence.
20 Aug 2024
Inspection of the vehicle shows damage that is mostly in line with the described impact. No earlier damage to the
vehicle is known, and nothing in the file suggests the damage predates the start of coverage.
28 Aug 2024
The shoulder injury reported by the claimant is plausible for a collision of this type. The claimant's medical records
show no prior injury to the same body area.
5 Sep 2024
Treatment has run somewhat longer than is usual for this injury, and the file is being reviewed against the treatment
plan. The claimant has added small details since the first statement, but the core account of the accident has stayed
the same.
29 Nov 2024
Baesd on the witness statements, photos, and the other driver's account, the accident is confirmed as described. The
shoulder injury claim remains open pending review of the treatment timeline.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
